title: Blunt-End-Single-Tube (BEST): Double-Stranded Ancient DNA Library Protocol
author: Michael V. Westbury

In a thermocycler, incubate the reaction for 00:30:00 min at 20 °C followed by 00:30:00 min at 65 °C and then cool to 4 °C It is important that the reaction is cooled to 4°C for complete deactivation. During this incubation (~1 h), prepare the ligation master mix (Step 8, below), and put it in a cold rack or on ice before using it.

REMINDER: UV-treat buffers for 10 min in a UV cross-linker before use, if not already done. After the adapter fill-in incubation is complete, add 450 μL modified PB (binding) buffer to the Monarch spin columns (one for each sample).

steps.title: Select and dilute adapters
steps.instruction: Choose the adapter concentration that matches the amount of input DNA (see table) and dilute the 200 µM stock as needed so that 1 µL of the chosen concentration is available per sample. For 100–400 ng DNA use 50 µM adapters, for 50–100 ng use 20 µM, for 30–50 ng use 10 µM, for 20–30 ng use 5 µM, for 10–20 ng use 3 µM, for 5–10 ng use 2 µM, for 1–5 ng use 1 µM. If you have 400 ng in 16 µL, dilute with EB buffer to the desired range.

steps.title: Prepare end‑repair master mix
steps.instruction: For N samples (plus one extra reaction) combine the following in a tube: 0.2 µL T4 DNA polymerase (3 U/µL) per sample, 0.5 µL T4 PNK (10 U/µL) per sample, 0.2 µL dNTP (25 mM) per sample, 2 µL 10× T4 DNA ligase buffer per sample, 1.1 µL reaction enhancer per sample, then bring to 4 µL total volume per sample. Prepare the reaction enhancer separately (see step below) and keep frozen until use.

substeps.instruction: Reaction enhancer: mix 500 µL 50 % PEG 4000 (stock), 100 µL 20 mg/mL BSA, 80 µL 5 M NaCl, add water to 1 mL total; this yields 25 % PEG, 2 mg/mL BSA, 400 mM NaCl.
Add 0.2 µL T4 DNA polymerase, 0.5 µL T4 PNK, 0.2 µL dNTP, 2 µL 10× ligase buffer, 1.1 µL reaction enhancer per sample.

steps.title: Add end‑repair mix to DNA
steps.instruction: In each PCR tube add 4 µL of the end‑repair master mix to 16 µL of DNA (USER‑treated or not) for a total volume of 20 µL. Mix gently.

steps.title: Incubate end‑repair and add adapter
steps.instruction: After the end‑repair incubation (as defined by the original protocol), place tubes on ice, add 1 µL of the selected adapter to each reaction (now 21 µL total), mix thoroughly by pipetting or flicking and spin down in a microcentrifuge.

steps.title: Prepare ligation master mix
steps.instruction: For N samples (plus one extra) combine: 0.5 µL 10× T4 DNA ligase buffer, 3 µL 50 % PEG 4000 (to give 6 % final), 0.5 µL T4 DNA ligase (400 U/µL) per sample, then bring to 4 µL total volume per sample.

steps.title: Add ligation mix to samples
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL of the ligation master mix to each 21 µL reaction (from previous step) to reach a total volume of 25 µL. Mix gently.

steps.title: Ligation incubation and prep fill‑in mix
steps.instruction: Incubate at 20 °C for 30 min, then 65 °C for 10 min, then cool to 4 °C (≈40 min total). While the ligation is incubating, prepare the adapter fill‑in master mix (see next step) and keep it on ice.

steps.title: Prepare adapter fill‑in master mix
steps.instruction: For N samples (plus one extra) combine: 1 µL 10× isothermal amplification buffer, 0.4 µL 25 mM dNTP, 0.8 µL Bst 2.0 WarmStart polymerase (8 U/µL), and 2.8 µL water per sample, yielding a 5 µL master mix per sample.

steps.title: Add adapter fill‑in mix
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of the adapter fill‑in master mix to each 25 µL ligation reaction, bringing the total volume to 30 µL. Mix gently.

steps.title: Bind library to spin column
steps.instruction: Add the entire 30 µL adapter‑fill‑in reaction to the modified PB (binding) buffer already present in the spin column and mix by pipetting to allow DNA binding.

steps.title: First spin‑column wash (PE buffer)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the spin column at 8,000 rpm for 1 min (temperature not critical). Discard the flow‑through into a 50 mL Falcon tube labelled “Qiagen waste”. Dry the collection tube by tapping it upside‑down on a folded paper towel (use a fresh towel for each sample).

steps.title: Second spin‑column wash and dry
steps.instruction: Add 650 µL PE buffer to the column, centrifuge at 8,000 rpm for 1 min, discard flow‑through, and dry the column as before by tapping on a fresh folded towel.

steps.title: Final column drying spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at maximum speed for 1 min to remove any residual PE buffer.

steps.title: Elute library from column
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a fresh 1.5 mL LoBind Eppendorf tube, add 16 µL EB (or EBT/TET) buffer to the centre of the membrane, incubate 5 min, then centrifuge at maximum speed for 1 min to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Second elution to reach 32 µL
steps.instruction: Repeat the elution step with another 16 µL EB buffer to obtain a final library volume of 32 µL.

steps.title: Store libraries at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Place the completed libraries at –20 °C until further use.
